about: [O5] The theatre: in under the marquee, a ticket at the box office, the house's doors, a seat, the reel (a still, held), up (brief O5 §2.10).

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('theatre1'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0, -1.6); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('theatre1'), F = s.frame; return [[1.0, -6.2]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('theatre1'), F = s.frame; N.controller.yaw = F.yaw(0); N.controller.pitch = -0.05; return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('theatre1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const p = F.w(K.spawnHouse.x, K.spawnHouse.z); const q = F.w(1.0, -8.9), r = F.w(K.spawnHouse.x, -8.9); return [[q.x, q.z], [r.x, r.z], [p.x, p.z]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('theatre1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const a = F.v(...((() => { const S = K.seats.find((x) => x.name === 'house'); return S.at; })())); const C = N.controller; C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); C.pitch = -0.3; return 1; })()
